name: get_capture_settings
description: Read the repeatable settings of one visible capture-history entry: its authored target, recipe, dependency pins and requested retention. No reason, recipients, grants, credentials or old pod selection. Repeat it with preview_capture history_capture_id.

cluster.description: Workload cluster of a hub-held DebugPolicy (ADR-228); the namespace names a namespace in that cluster.

maxPods.description: Maximum pods collected per occurrence; never the monitoring coverage limit.

source.description: Source object of an organization or namespace captureProfile dependency. A release-embedded builtin profile (ADR-243) has none; its profileComposition provenance names the builtin catalog.

d30.description: Pinned resolved profile. A builtin definition is embedded in the release binary (ADR-243) and is identified by its definition digest alone; organization and namespace definitions name their source cluster, namespace and object.
